title: Wiscon Industries IPO Details
intro:
Wiscon Industries IPO is a book build issue of ₹110.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 43.14 lakh shares aggregating to ₹88.01 crores and offer for sale of 10.78 lakh shares aggregating to ₹22.00 crores.

Wiscon Industries IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 27, 2026 and will close on Oct 29, 2026. The allotment for the Wiscon Industries IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 30, 2026. Wiscon Industries IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 3, 2026.

Wiscon Industries IPO is set issue price band at ₹194 to ₹204 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,44,800 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,67,200.

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Wiscon Industries IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2022, Wiscon Industries Limited is a Delhi-based company engaged in the trading and supply of consumer electronic products across India.
The company offers a broad range of products, including LED TVs, air coolers, washing machines, and air conditioners under its flagship "Wiscon" brand.
It also sells electric scooters sourced from third-party brands.

Wiscon serves both business customers (B2B) and individual consumers (B2C). Its products are distributed through an offline dealer and distributor network as well as its own online platform, allowing the company to reach customers across the country. Sales operations are managed by a dedicated team working from the company's registered office.

The company has reported strong revenue growth since its incorporation. Revenue from operations increased from ₹ 321.45 lakh in FY 2023-24 to ₹1,449.27 lakh in FY 2024-25, and further to ₹7,339.16 lakh in FY 2025-26, reflecting significant business expansion over the three-year period.
As of September 30, 2026, Wiscon Industries had 76 permanent employees supporting its operations.
strengths: Offers a diversified portfolio of consumer electronic products catering to different customer segments.
Serves customers through both B2B and B2C sales channels, including its own online platform.
Maintains an established after-sales service network to support customers across India.
Led by an experienced management team with execution expertise.
Supported by a skilled workforce that helps drive business growth and operational efficiency.

faqs.question: How to apply in Wiscon Industries IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Wiscon Industries IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Wiscon Industries IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Wiscon Industries IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: You can apply in Wiscon Industries IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
